title: Quality-Time Hours by Week Type
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=relationship:ritual
| search ritual_type="quality_time" duration_hr=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(duration_hr) as duration_hr by _time week_type
| sort - _time
description: Tracks quality-time hours over time and breaks it out by week type.
value: Week-type splits help you see whether busier weeks still protect any real togetherness.
implementation: Send quality-time hours events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of quality-time hours by week type.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how quality-time hours changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
